notes.title: Celebrate for my favortive idol recovery and the game update, the price 50%OFF
notes.content:
Dear All, 
here is Mr.H, since get the translate issue of the game. We spend three month to solve this problem. Please tell us if the translate is improve or not. Sorry that we are not the native language of English. But hope this improve can that everyone have fun on the game.

Here I want to recommend the best I idol I like. That is Hololive Vtuber, Hoshimachi Suisei. She is a cute idol and sing very well. Although she has a surgery recently, she will come back soon. Maybe play this game or watch VOD before she come back?

Finally I will list the things I update this time. And some are still making, and before it, just that me short introduce my next game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41614476/e269a5385896deb6ac3166dc23b6211adddcbb77.png[/img]
The next game, Hypnosis Prison. The main character is the warden in the morning. But with full heart of justice. She will stalke the badguys at night and try to grab them to the prision. What will the story be? If is possible just follow my next game. Thanks a lot.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41614476/2ae19189753c2c3521796762ca0542445c1cbb1f.png[/img]
